create_transformer_config: create a TransformerConfig with embedding_dim, num_layers, num_heads, and positional_encodings parameters
build_transformer_encoder: build a TransformerEncoder that embeds sequences, adds positional encodings, and applies multi-head attention layers
build_chunked_transformer: build a ChunkedTransformerEncoder that handles large histories by splitting inputs into chunks for independent encoding
build_multihead_attention: build a MultiHeadDotProductAttention module supporting relative, rotary, noisy, and ALiBi positional encodings with sliding windows
make_transformer_model: make a transformer model function with make_transformer specifying output_size, transformer_module, and positional encoding type
